description: Protected Zone Plots Additional GB 10K Grid 2014 is a dataset listed in UK national open data portal, an open data portal, published or maintained by Forestry Commission. Survey sites used to confirm the absence/presence of bark beetle species, Pinewood Nematode and Pitch Pine Canker. The PZ plots defined by this set of data reflect a proposed 2 year, annual survey as described. Some of these plots sites may be taken up in the ongoing permanent PZ plot surveys. Coverage: United Kingdom. The portal files it under the publisher Forestry Commission. Its tags are 2014, GB, Species distribution, Tree Health, environment. The portal shows 2025-07-25 as the last metadata change. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is not stated on the portal listing (dataset page not read). Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support electricity network, generation and charging-infrastructure studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-ckan-uk-portal.
